title: Meta-Harness: search over the harness, gate on held-out tasks and models

ran_on.router: OpenRouter, one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for both models, key in VLLM_API_KEY

notes.arms: There is no trained arm, so checks.train_seeds is null. base and baseline are both 00_baseline, the unsearched harness, on the 30 held-out asks; recipe is 02_check_result, the candidate the gate picked out of three, in one round. steps counts training steps and this recipe takes none.
notes.delta: The paired holdout delta the run printed (README, Result), not the difference of the two rounded means. On the held-out model the same pair is +0.09 [+0.04, +0.15]. Both exclude zero; 0 held-out tasks the baseline passed and the pick failed.
notes.run_std: Four baseline draws on Haiku over the same 30 held-out asks, out/tasks.jsonl replayed and nothing redrawn: 0.62, 0.65, 0.69, 0.61. eval_variance run_std 0.038, and noise_band(0.038, df=3) = 0.17 is the band a one-run-per-side delta has to clear. +0.38 clears it; the +0.03 between the two winning candidates does not, and the recipe calls that a tie.
notes.over_optimized: Not measured. This recipe reports a harness-vs-model attribution instead (the harness explains 61% [47..77] of the spread, the model 17% [10..25]), which answers a different question than proxy versus target. Until the proxy the search optimised is scored against the target the recipe claims, the verdict stays unresolved: recipes/papers/check.py refuses moved without a proxy-vs-target verdict (#809).
notes.decontaminated_dropped: Not measured for this run. The 60 asks were drawn once and split 30/30 by seed, which is run.py's 'split by seed' path and does no 8-gram pass; the --traces path runs wai.decontaminate and records the count in out/split.json.
notes.hack_scan_top: Not run. The judge is a program and the recipe reports the judge's own failure reasons instead: on the baseline, 46 of 120 held-out rows failed, 40 of them for an apology.
notes.length: Mean reply length in characters on the Haiku holdout: 761 for the baseline, 168 for the pick. length_after.baseline is the baseline itself, because the baseline arm and the base arm are the same harness here.
notes.usd: about two dollars of OpenRouter credit for the whole run
